0022600119.text: The Wizards, 2-1 and sixth in the East, make their fourth trip of the season to face the 2-1 Hornets, who sit fifth in the East and second in the Southeast, with Washington 1-0 on the road and Charlotte 1-1 at home. Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip pinched nerve), while Charlotte is without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Kylan Boswell (knee surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Wizards lost all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 129-112 in Washington on February 22, 2026.
